seeds.per_season_iid: 115 + (index in ALL_SEASONS - 10): 2005-06 -> 105 ... 2015-16 -> 115 ... 2025-26 -> 125 (identical to run_all.py's per-season seeds for 2015-16..2025-26)
seeds.pooled_bootstrap: reuses the per-season iid replicates: pooled replicate b = replicate b of every season

meta.description: Workstream B: Premier League home advantage 2005-06..2025-26. Per-season Poisson gamma with bootstrap CIs and the goals-ratio identity check; common-gamma tests; crowd-status fits 2019-20..2021-22 (E0, D1, SP1); date-block and team-cluster bootstraps; CI coverage and cold-start recovery; fit diagnostics. Attendance is not in the data: crowd status is flagged from match dates.
meta.identity: For a double round robin with geometric-mean(alpha)=1, gamma_hat = sum home goals / sum away goals exactly, and extra home goals per match = mean H - mean A.

common_gamma_20_crowd_seasons.how: pooled MLE, season-specific strengths and one shared gamma over the 20 seasons 2005-06..2025-26 except 2020-21 (= sum H / sum A); common-gamma interval: percentile CI from 2000 season-stratified bootstrap refits

common_gamma_21_seasons.how: as common_gamma_20_crowd_seasons but all 21 seasons; common-gamma interval

gamma_2020_21.how: per-season MLE (= sum H / sum A); percentile CI from 2000 iid match-bootstrap refits, seed 120

gamma_2024_25.how: per-season MLE (= sum H / sum A); percentile CI from 2000 iid match-bootstrap refits, seed 124

extra_home_goals_2020_21.how: mean(lambda - lambda/gamma) = mean H - mean A (identity); percentile CI from 2000 iid bootstrap refits

extra_home_goals_common_20_crowd_seasons.how: pooled common-gamma fit, mean(lambda - lambda/gamma); season-stratified bootstrap percentile CI

identity_max_abs_gamma_minus_goals_ratio.how: max over 21 seasons of |gamma_hat (L-BFGS-B) - sum home goals / sum away goals|; 'ci' is [min, max] over seasons, not a confidence interval; pooled fits: max 3.4e-07; extra-goals identity: max 3.8e-07
